chunks: They answered: "We have (in any case) to go back to our Lord."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the phrase 'We are returning to our Lord' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration by the prophets and their followers underscores the inevitability of *Ma'ad* (return to God) and serves as a model of steadfastness (*thabat*) in the face of worldly trials. It highlights the theological principle that true monotheism entails recognizing one's ultimate accountability before Allah, reinforcing the concept of resurrection as a natural consequence of divine justice.
